query: What signals in a travel-expense description predict whether it will be declined?

per_column.name: asset_category
per_column.rationale: Clean, well-separated categorical variable (hardware/travel/cloud_service/etc.) that can be grouped and compared against decline rates. Interpretable and external to the focus.

per_column.name: asset_brand_vendor
per_column.rationale: Vendor/brand is an interpretable associational dimension; despite some NULLs the categories are distinct and segmentable for comparing decline behavior.

per_column.name: action_type
per_column.rationale: Distinct action categories provide a meaningful axis to segment records and compare against decline rates.

per_column.name: creation_method
per_column.rationale: Binary manual/automated with a balanced split (320/180); highly interpretable and a plausible signal for review outcome. Strong EDA segmentation.

per_column.name: description_specificity
per_column.rationale: Directly relevant to the query about description signals; three well-separated, interpretable levels that can be compared against decline outcomes.

per_column.name: has_source_id
per_column.rationale: Boolean flag with a usable split (327/173); interpretable and segmentable, offers a data-completeness axis to compare against declines.

per_column.name: is_luxury_or_premium
per_column.rationale: Conceptually relevant (premium items may be scrutinized) but the split is near-constant (488 false vs 12 true), so meaningful comparison is weak — too rare to draw stable relationships.

per_column.name: department_group
per_column.rationale: Interpretable organizational segmentation with distinct categories; useful for comparing decline rates across groups. Partly redundant with original 'department' but coarser/cleaner.

per_column.name: hardware_subtype
per_column.rationale: Interpretable subtype categories; though heavily NULL for non-hardware rows, it still supports segmentation within the hardware slice.

judge.rationale: The set offers mostly clean, interpretable, well-separated categorical variables external to state_declined that a human can group on and compare against decline outcomes (creation_method, description_specificity, asset_category, action_type, has_source_id are especially strong). Several are directly aligned with the query's focus on description/process signals. Weaknesses: is_luxury_or_premium is near-constant and gives little comparative leverage, department_group partially restates an existing column, and hardware_subtype/asset_brand_vendor carry substantial NULLs that fragment segmentation. Overall a genuinely exploratory, understanding-oriented set rather than opaque scores, but with a few low-yield columns.
